data.message: I commit to 18 tons and propose individual opt-in, not unanimity. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even all 18 leaves 50, but next stock may be 100: long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Willing recruiters, please help.
